scope: This guide covers robot-mounted consumables for the U.S. eufy RoboVac 11S MAX (model T2126). It does not cover the standard RoboVac 11S (T2108) or self-empty dock bags; the 11S MAX uses a charging base, not an auto-empty station.
warning: Check the robot label for T2126 / 11S MAX. The standard 11S (T2108) has a different filter assembly; this guide's 3-in-1 filter is eufy part T29151N2. Match the part number and selected model on the listing before checkout.

compatibility.detail: The 11S MAX (T2126) uses one 3-in-1 unibody filter. The standard 11S (T2108) manual section shows a separate high-performance filter, foam filter and pre-filter. Do not choose a filter by the shared “11S” name alone.
eufy’s T2907031 rolling brush listing includes the 11S MAX. The Amazon card is the single-brush offer; its brush guard is not included.

The manual lists both as replaceable robot parts. eufy’s T29161N2 Max-series kit is listed for the 11S MAX and includes four side brushes and one brush guard. A standalone Amazon side-brush page had no featured offer when checked, so it is not presented as a buy card.
The 11S MAX has a charging base, not a self-emptying dock, so there is no dock dust bag to replace.

careTip: Turn the robot off before servicing it. Clean the filter with a vacuum or cleaning brush rather than washing it, and let any part that gets wet dry completely before use. Remove hair from the rolling brush before replacing it.

questions.question: Which replacement filter fits the RoboVac 11S MAX?
questions.answer: For model T2126, choose eufy’s T29151N2 unibody 3-in-1 filter. The standard 11S (T2108) uses a different three-piece filter assembly, so a generic listing that only says “11S” is not enough to confirm fit.

questions.question: Can I wash the 11S MAX replacement filter?
questions.answer: eufy describes T29151N2 as non-washable. Clean dust from it with a vacuum or cleaning brush, and follow the current manufacturer instructions if the filter becomes wet.

questions.question: Does the eufy 11S MAX use dock dust bags?
questions.answer: No. Its charging base does not empty the robot’s dust collector into a disposable bag. The model’s consumables include the robot filter and brushes instead.

questions.question: Where can I find 11S MAX side brushes and a brush guard?
questions.answer: eufy lists a Max-series maintenance kit, T29161N2, for the 11S MAX. The manufacturer describes that kit as including four side brushes and a brush guard. Check the current eufy kit contents and exact model before buying.
